skills.detail:
Increases own SPD.
Deals a long-range area attack with a Knockback effect.
Attack ignores obstacles.
Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
Acquires SPD debuff effect at Level 5.
skills.name: Swordsman's Slash

skills.detail:
Begin charging by holding down the skill button. If you let go of the skill button before the charge has completed, the charge will cancel and you will attack normally. If the charge has finished, you will unleash a different attack.
Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.

Not Charged: A mid-range area attack with a Knockback effect.
Damage dealt will disregard damage reduction.

Charged: A long-range area attack with a Knockback effect. Damage dealt will disregard the enemy DEF stat.
skills.name: Charged Slash
